title: UK retail sales, Great Britain — December 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the Christmas-trading volume print, two days after the December CPI/PPI pair
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/retailsalesgreatbritaindecember2026, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'Retail Sales; Great Britain: December 2026', 'Release date: 22 January 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published'. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has CENSUS: for the US retail print and no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the adjacency sweep of the never-assessed initial research of uk-ppi-2027-01-20, 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-ppi-2027-01-20 LANE, 2026-09-10, two days after its own event and inside its five-day corridor. It is the exact structural twin of proposals/uk-retail-sales-2026-10-23.from-uk-ppi-2026-10-21.json, filed by this same chain a day earlier for the same reason and on the same cadence — the ONS publishes GB retail sales two days after the CPI/PPI pair, and this calendar tracks the price and labour sides of that week and not the demand side. THREE REASONS IT EARNS A SLOT. FIRST, IT IS THE CHRISTMAS PRINT: December 2026 is the reference month, so this is the first hard read on UK consumer volumes through the trading period that follows the 2026-10-28 Autumn Budget and the 2026-10-01 electricity VAT zero-rate — the demand-side counterpart to a quarter this calendar already researches on the price side five times over. SECOND, PLACEMENT: it closes an ONS corridor this calendar tracks four times over (uk-gdp-monthly-2027-01-15, uk-labour-market-2027-01-19, then uk-cpi-2027-01-20 and uk-ppi-2027-01-20 in the same 07:00 minute), and it lands 13 days before the 2027-02-04 MPC announcement carrying the February Monetary Policy Report — inside the window whose data the MPR conditions on. THIRD, IT IS DATED WHERE ITS SIBLINGS ARE NOT: the publisher's forward PPI calendar runs out at 2027-01-20 (ons.gov.uk/releases/producerpriceinflationukjanuary2027 gives 'Provisional release date: February 2027', month only), so 22 January 2027 is among the last firm 07:00 London dates on the ONS site in this window. NAME COLLISION WORTH ONE SENTENCE IN ANY RECAP: this calendar's retail-sales-* entries are the US Census print — nominal receipts, different publisher, different concept from GB volumes. Expected LOW on the same measured grounds as every UK sibling in this chain: symbols: [], no UK-listed name in this book, no sterling- or rates-keyed house playbook. Only the release page itself was fetched — no December-reference-month cadence listing was reproduced — so its own never-assessed research should verify the cadence before relying on it, exactly as the 10-23 proposal asked. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
